visual.name: budgetBulletChart
visual.description: Annual budget versus cumulative actuals per period, split into revenue and costs, with one panel per group.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: One bar group per period. Add a date hierarchy or several fields (year, quarter, month) to drill down; expand all down shows the levels as a nested axis.

dataRoles.name: group
dataRoles.description: One panel per value. A field parameter works here. Leave empty for a single panel.

dataRoles.name: component
dataRoles.description: Revenue or cost. Values that start with one of the revenue values in Grouping count as revenue; everything else counts as cost.

dataRoles.name: legend
dataRoles.description: Optional. Splits every budget and actual bar into one bar per value and colors the budget bars by value. Set the colors under Colors.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: One or more budget measures. Fields pair by order with Actual YTD: the first budget with the first actual, and so on. Field names (or Rename for this visual) are used as pair names.

dataRoles.name: actual
dataRoles.description: One or more actual measures. Fields pair by order with Budget: the first actual with the first budget, and so on.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Optional. One or more target measures. Fields pair by order with Budget and Actual YTD: the first target belongs to the first pair, and so on.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra fields shown in the tooltip.
